findings.text: An unrestricted Grok 4.6 configuration was given to third-party cyber evaluators who corroborated internal results.

source.quote:
We additionally provided an unrestricted configuration of Grok 4.6 to third-party evaluators,
who corroborated the results of our internal evaluations and testing on cyber capabilities.

findings.text: An earlier Grok 4.6 checkpoint sped up its own chat inference in five hours, opening seven pull requests (PRs); three now serve production with 1.5% decode and 3.1% prefill throughput gains.
